SWZ.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
Only health information systems are described; no finance, tax or payroll system.

facts.fact: Health Information Management Systems (HMIS Eswatini), a programme within the Ministry of Health, is the technical lead for the health information systems, including the CMIS patient-records system, operating in 250 health facilities, per Eswatini Positive News.

The CMIS, which supports recording, storage and retrieval of patient information, and the eLMIS operate in 250 health facilities across Eswatini, per Eswatini Positive News; the report gives no total of facilities or split by system.

SWZ.note: Document describes a stock system and a patient-records system; no national routine reporting system is stated.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No ID number at birth is mentioned.
Nothing on who runs the national ID system.
National identity numbers identify patients in the health systems, which are not a register of the kinds the study lists; no register is stated to be keyed on the number.
Nothing on the national ID system's status.
